title: pteris glabra
intro: Pteris glabra, commonly known as the Ladder Fern, is a species of fern native to tropical Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to help lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pteris glabra include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties, making it a useful remedy for treating fever, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Pteris glabra include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential therapeutic applications.
